messages.content: not sure what to do at night, I want to stay up and meditate sitting down and not sleeping

From [teacher-answer] why night meditation bites back (practice-timing guidance) :: https://www.artofliving.org/us-en/blog/can-not-sleep-why-meditation-at-night-might-be-keeping-you-up-late, it's noted that "energising breath/mantra work done at night can keep you awake for hours; dulling practices clouded by sleepiness lose clarity benefits."

What is driving your desire to stay up and meditate at night?
